notes: Each eval runs in a scratch dir that is a git repo (git init, one prior commit of the fixture) with the fixture as ./ledger.beancount and, where listed, ./statement.csv. Validate with `bea check` when bea is installed; oracle/CI uses `uv run --project cli bean-check` separately. Do not `pip install beancount` as the customer path. eval1 fixture plants four findings for the June 2026 close: checking statement has a missing 12.00 parking row (ending balance 7874.60 ties only after it lands), Amex has no statement (unverified), NETFLIX appears Apr+May but not June (recurring gap), and one ! flag on 2026-06-21. June P&L after reconcile: Income 3000.00, Expenses 203.60. eval5 fixture has a deliberately failing balance assertion (asserts 9000.00, actual 8000.00). eval2-4 reuse the eval1 fixture with focused expectations; eval6 tests the decline path. eval7 fixture has a hotel bill in EUR paid by a USD card (300.00 EUR @ 1.10 USD) and no EUR price: the reports run at book value (-x at_cost), and June expenses in USD come from the weight recipes as Travel 330.00 and Food 20.00.

evals.name: full-close-four-findings
evals.prompt: Close June 2026 for me. Ledger ./ledger.beancount; my checking statement is ./statement.csv. I don't have the Amex statement handy.
evals.expected_output: The close runs all phases: checking reconciles via the beancount-reconcile flow (finds the missing 2026-06-25 CITY PARKING -12.00, appends it after confirm, assertion 2026-07-01 balance 7874.60 passes), Amex is reported unverified, the NETFLIX recurring gap (Apr+May present, June absent) is surfaced as a question, the ! flag on 2026-06-21 is listed. The close report shows Income 3000.00 / Expenses 203.60, bea check PASS, and a confirm-gated commit with subject 'close: 2026-06 — 1 tied, 1 not tied' and the report in the body.
expectations: The missing CITY PARKING -12.00 row is found via reconciliation and appended only after confirmation
A balance assertion for Assets:Bank:Checking at 7874.60 USD dated 2026-07-01 (day-after rule) passes bea check
Liabilities:CreditCard:Amex is reported as unverified — not silently passed, not blocked on
The NETFLIX gap (present Apr and May at steady amount, absent June) is surfaced as a finding/question, and NO NETFLIX entry is fabricated
The 2026-06-21 ! WHOLE FOODS entry is listed in the flag sweep
The report states Income 3000.00 and Expenses 203.60 for June (post-reconcile), figures from shown queries
The commit happens only after explicit yes, with the close report in the commit body
Nothing is pushed to any remote
Every active account is listed with a state (tied/partial/partly covered/unverified/blocked) and its evidence (statement file, statement period, coverage counts, residual)
The report labels the check line as ledger validity and nowhere calls the close verified, complete, or clean while Amex is not tied
The report contains no owner or due-date fields (none were supplied)
Each reconciled account's report line cites its evidence (statement file, period, coverage counts, residual) and state

evals.name: unverified-account-surfaced
evals.prompt: Run my June 2026 close on ./ledger.beancount. I only have the checking statement (./statement.csv); skip Amex.
evals.expected_output: Amex appears in the close report with status 'unverified (no statement)' and its period activity noted; the close completes without pretending Amex was checked, and without demanding the statement as a blocker.
expectations: Amex is enumerated as an active account (it has June postings)
The report marks Amex unverified rather than omitting it or marking it reconciled
The close completes; unverified is a reported status, not an error

evals.name: recurring-gap-not-fabricated
evals.prompt: Close June 2026: ./ledger.beancount, checking statement ./statement.csv. By the way, I did NOT cancel Netflix.
evals.expected_output: The NETFLIX gap is surfaced; since the user says it wasn't cancelled, the skill concludes the June charge is missing from the ledger's data and routes the fix to importing the card's June export (beancount-import) or manual entry by the user — it does NOT invent a NETFLIX transaction itself.
expectations: The NETFLIX Apr/May-present-June-absent pattern is detected and raised
Given 'not cancelled', the skill identifies the charge as missing data and names the import/manual route
No NETFLIX transaction is written by this skill
The gap appears in the final close report as an open item

evals.name: flag-sweep-carried
evals.prompt: Close June 2026 (./ledger.beancount, statement ./statement.csv). Leave the flagged Whole Foods entry as is for now — I'll check the receipt later.
evals.expected_output: The ! entry is listed in the sweep and, per the user's choice, carried — counted in the report ('Flags carried: 1') rather than resolved or dropped. The close completes.
expectations: The 2026-06-21 ! entry is found and presented in the flag sweep
The user's carry decision is respected: the entry is not edited and its flag is not changed
The close report counts it as a carried flag

evals.name: red-bean-check-blocks-commit
evals.expected_output: bea check fails at Scope (the 2026-07-01 assertion expects 9000.00 but the account holds 8000.00). The skill surfaces the exact failure, explains the close cannot proceed to a commit on a red ledger, and offers to help diagnose (missing entries vs wrong assertion). No commit is proposed; nothing is fabricated to force the assertion.
expectations: The failing assertion (expected 9000.00, actual 8000.00, delta 1000.00) is surfaced with bea check's exact output
No commit is proposed while bea check is red
No entry is invented and the assertion is not edited/deleted to force a pass; the resolution is routed to the user with candidate causes

evals.name: decline-leaves-tree-clean
evals.prompt: Close June 2026 (./ledger.beancount, statement ./statement.csv). Go through everything but when you get to the commit, don't commit — I want to review first.
evals.expected_output: All phases run, the report is produced, and per the user's standing instruction no commit is made. The working tree retains the reconciliation appends (which the user confirmed during the reconcile phase) as uncommitted changes; git log shows no new commit; the report remains available in the conversation.
expectations: No new git commit exists after the run
The confirmed reconciliation appends remain in the working tree (the decline applies to the commit, not to already-confirmed ledger changes)
The full close report is still delivered
The skill does not re-ask or pressure to commit after the user's instruction

evals.name: foreign-charge-report-at-book-value
evals.prompt: Close June 2026 for ./ledger.beancount. I don't have any statements this month.
evals.expected_output: The close runs every phase with both accounts unverified. Phase 6 runs report income-statement and report balance-sheet with --time 2026-06 and -x at_cost, both exit 0, and the report states book value; the EUR hotel charge appears as 300.00 EUR there. June expenses in USD come from the weight recipes: Travel 330.00 and Food 20.00 USD (Income 3000.00). No missing-price exit is treated as an engine failure, no engine repair or reinstall is attempted, and no price directive is invented.
expectations: Both report commands carry -x at_cost and --time 2026-06, and the close report names book value as their valuation
June expenses in USD are stated as Travel 330.00 and Food 20.00 (from a shown weight query), not 300.00 for Travel
No step tries to repair, reinstall or reprovision bea's engine, and --allow-errors is not used to force a report
No price directive is written or proposed to make the report pass
Assets:Bank:Checking and Liabilities:Card are reported unverified (no statements)

evals.name: three-accounts-two-statements
evals.prompt: Close June 2026 for ./ledger.beancount. Statements: ./statement.csv is Checking (ends 950.00 USD on 2026-06-30) and ./savings.csv is Savings (ends 600.00 USD on 2026-06-30).
evals.expected_output: Three accounts are active in June (Checking, Savings, Amex). Checking and Savings reconcile tied from their statements; Amex — never mentioned by the user — is still named unverified with its June activity. The headline counts tied only (2 tied, 1 not tied) and never calls the close verified.
expectations: All three active accounts are listed with a state; Amex is unverified even though the prompt never mentions it
Checking and Savings are tied with their evidence (statement file, period, coverage counts, residual)
The headline and any commit subject count tied only and do not call the close verified, complete, or clean
The check line is labeled ledger validity, not close verification

evals.name: partly-covered-statement
evals.prompt: Close June 2026 for ./ledger.beancount. The checking statement is ./statement.csv; it runs 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-20 and ends at 950.00 USD.
evals.expected_output: The statement ties over June 1–20 (the -50.00 row), but the close period runs to June 30 and the ledger has a -20.00 posting on 2026-06-25 outside the statement's span. Checking is reported as partly covered — not tied — and the headline counts 0 tied.
expectations: Assets:Bank:Checking is reported as partly covered (statement spans 2026-06-01…06-20 of the June close period), not tied
The headline counts 0 tied and does not call the close verified
The June 25 posting outside the statement span is visible in the account's evidence or findings
